title: The Father at His Inmost
description: A sustained meditation on the Lord at his source. T19 explains why "Father" belongs to the Lord at every register where he stands as foundation — in the inmost as unmeasurable source, in the calling as bearer of living fire, in the shining as rooted abode of wisdom, in the lifting as standing way of return. T20 expounds the First Father in his five members of light (the rational at its highest), with five attributes proceeding from him: light, fragrance, voice, greatness gushing forth, and revelation. T21 describes the Land of Light — the great country where everything that lives lives from him, where the forms are beautiful because nothing has been added by claim, where there is no falsity and no death. T22 sets the unchanging existence of light from before eternity against what the soul has claimed, which has its end already prepared.
